title: Twenty seconds of low-rate harmless commands
threat_model: No attacker. A user runs a few ordinary commands (list a directory, read a harmless file, search it, print the date) with pauses in between.
notes: Eight commands, each followed by a 2.5 second sleep, so the process rate stays far under the threshold of rapid_spawn. The files are in the scenario work directory, and nothing in /etc is read.
